dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular, jagged white perimeters forming distinct 'O' and 'C' shapes; these structures exhibit a sharp pixel gradient from the dark charcoal coat to a bright white border, often enclosing a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid white pixel clusters, primarily situated at the intersections of the annuli network in the upper dorsal region, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest closed-ring structures on the mid-dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented along the longitudinal axis of the subject.

other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, interconnected reticulated network where high-contrast lines form a continuous lace-like pattern across the visible dorsal area.
